sources.notes: Description: Morphology; USNM114255 / ROM61113 specimen captions; Ecology interpretive limits. Supports: Bivalved suboval anterior-tapering carapace and straight dorsal hinge; prominent forward stalked oval eyes; one stout segmented antenna pair; ten thorax segments with flattened flap appendages, seven abdomen segments and forked tail. Species differ in size and tail proportions.

sources.notes: Aesthetic input, never factual authority. Original replacement sheet genuinely inspected; retain paired valves, forward eyes, swimming flaps, abdomen and fork. Discard AI texture and apparent ring count inconsistencies. Build exactly seven exposed abdomen segments, ten paired flap-bearing thorax stations, two eyes/two antennae/two rami. Tail rami are unsegmented tapering forks rather than AI jointed third antenna-like structures. Straight dorsal hinge and suboval valve outlines; two closed thickened domed shells with open ventral separation reveal flattened flaps. No claws or walking legs, no shrimp tail fan. Source says swimming; root is floor-centered minimum display support extent, not assertion animal walks.
